intent.description: Home internet connection repeatedly drops, disconnects or goes offline intermittently
examples: My internet keeps disconnecting every evening
The connection drops several times a day

intent.description: Internet or mobile data speed is much slower than expected or promised
examples: My download speed is far below my plan
Videos keep buffering and pages load slowly

intent.description: Router, modem, Wi-Fi hub, set-top box or other customer equipment is malfunctioning
examples: The light on my router is red
My TV box shows an error code

intent.description: Customer disputes a charge, invoice amount, fee, double payment or billing after cancellation
examples: I was charged twice this month
My bill is higher than expected

intent.description: Customer wants to upgrade, downgrade or otherwise change their plan, package or contract
examples: I want to move to a faster package
Can I switch to a cheaper tariff?

intent.description: Mobile phone has no signal, cannot register on the network, make calls, send SMS or has coverage problems
examples: My phone says no service after changing SIM
I cannot make calls or send texts

intent.description: Customer cannot log in, reset a password, receive verification codes, or suspects account takeover
examples: I forgot my password and the reset email never comes
I think someone hacked my account

intent.description: Service is down for a whole area, street, building or cell tower affecting many customers
examples: The whole street has no internet
Everyone in our area lost mobile coverage

intent.description: Problems with installing or activating a new connection, including missed engineer appointments
examples: The engineer did not turn up
My new line is installed but not active

product.description: Fixed home broadband or fibre internet service
examples: home broadband service

product.description: Mobile phone service: SIM, calls, texts and mobile data
examples: mobile phone plan

product.description: Home router, modem, Wi-Fi hub and wireless network equipment
examples: home router and wifi

product.description: Television service with set-top box or IPTV streaming box
examples: TV box and channels

product.description: Customer account, billing, login, plan and payments
examples: my customer account

severity.description: Disrupts normal use but there are workarounds
Significant impact on work, income or household; needs same-day attention
Safety risk, total loss of a business-critical service or prolonged complete outage

sentiment.description: Customer is exasperated after repeated failed attempts
Customer is anxious or worried and wants reassurance
